title: agnus-castus incisa
intro: Agnus-castus incisa, commonly known as New Zealand Chasteberry, is a plant species in the family Vitaceae. It is traditionally used to support menstrual and reproductive health in women, offering benefits such as relief from menstrual cramps, PMS symptoms, and menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Agnus-castus incisa are attributed to its ability to modulate hormonal balance, particularly the regulation of estrogen and progesterone levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
